_schema: minion_base_stats.json: one record per player-minion actor (minion_actors.json). health = UnitHealth; innateStats = ActorStats.stats (minion's own Stats list); protection = non-zero serialized ProtectionClass fields; movement.baseSpeed = NavMeshAgent.m_Speed; abilities = base attacks with damage from abilities.json; summonSettings = SummonEntityOnDeath on the summoning ability prefab; mutators = non-default *Mutator fields on the minion prefab. See research/07j §4.
